name: Air Fryer Garlic-Herb Lamb Chops with Mashed Potatoes and Green Beans

components.name: Garlic-Herb Lamb Chops

ingredients.name: Raw boneless lamb loin chops, roughly 8 pieces
Mixed fresh rosemary and thyme, finely chopped

steps: Mix 25 ml olive oil, grated garlic, fresh herbs, salt and pepper; rub over the lamb chops. Keep refrigerated until ready to cook.

Preheat air fryer to 190 C. Arrange lamb chops in one layer and cook for around 10-14 minutes in batches, turning at the halfway point. Check the thickest piece with a thermometer; whole lamb cuts should reach at least 63 C with a 3-minute rest.
Rest the cooked chops for at least 3 minutes, then divide with mashed potatoes and green beans into four portions. Store lamb and mash separately where practical.
Freeze lamb portions if necessary; mashed potatoes can be frozen but may need reheating with extra milk. Green beans are best eaten early.

components.name: Mashed Potatoes

ingredients.name: Raw floury potatoes, peeled and cubed

steps: Peel and cube potatoes, simmer in water until tender, and drain thoroughly; mash with warm milk, butter and the listed salt.

components.name: Lemon Green Beans

ingredients.name: Raw green beans, topped and tailed

steps: Steam or boil the green beans until barely tender, then toss with lemon juice and 10 ml oil.

Original BBC Good Food recipe provides herbed lamb chops; mashed potato and green bean weights are UNHANGRY additions for a full dinner.
Planning: Secondary stovetop for mash and beans. Chops intended boneless for nutrition calculations; swap bone-in only after adjusting edible raw weight.

Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
